ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast bimodal distribution; approximately 65% high-intensity (white) pixels and 35% low-intensity (black/dark-grey) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant white distal lobes with dark pigmentation concentrated along the leading edges and radiating from the fluke base. Distinct dark circular spots located on the upper-left and center-right high-intensity white regions.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch with an approximate 50-degree internal angle; depth is roughly 15% of the visible vertical extent of the fluke.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular jagged serrations along the entire trailing edge; pixel-level peak amplitudes vary significantly, creating a highly textured linear boundary against the background.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly convex curvature along the outer distal edges of both lobes, tapering to acute, narrow tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Visible clusters of high-contrast white barnacle formations at both distal tips; multiple dark ring-shaped (ocellus-like) markings scattered across the high-intensity white fields.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Extensive network of white, unaligned horizontal and diagonal linear rake marks concentrated in the low-intensity dark pigmentation area at the fluke base.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant linear rake marks crossing the central fluke area; localized clusters of barnacle colonization on the extreme tips of both lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Multiple dark circular 'target' or 'bullseye' markings present on the high-intensity white surfaces of both the left and right lobes.
